name: OpenAI API
desc: Hosted API for GPT, image, audio and video models.
desc_zh: OpenAI 托管的模型 API，涵盖文本、图像、语音与视频。
solves: Wiring a model means handling auth, retries, billing, and rate limits yourself. These endpoints do that part.
solves_zh: 自己接模型要处理鉴权、重试、计费和限流。这套接口替你做掉这一层。
best_for: You are adding a model to your own product and do not want to run the plumbing.
best_for_zh: 你要给自己的产品接一个模型，又不想自己维护那套管道。
